bio.text: Vincent Candelora is the Connecticut House Republican Leader and represents the 86th District, serving North Branford, Durham, East Haven and Guilford; he was elected to his 10th term in November 2024.

He first became House Republican Leader in 2020, after serving as a Deputy House Republican Leader, and before the legislature served three terms on North Branford's Town Council, one as deputy mayor.
He helps run two family-owned businesses, a manufacturing company and a sportsplex, and has practiced municipal and transactional law.
He graduated from Connecticut College in 1992 and from the Dickinson School of Law at Penn State in 1995, and is married with three children.
